control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: residual pressure found after isolation of HT-9004

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on HT-9004 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling traffic on operating areas, specifically applying positive communication before approach. HT-9004 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 18 September 2005 a near hit was recorded on HT-9004 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during a planned shutdown; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
